newsitem.title: USA: Harveys Casino to sell Hard Rock stake.
newsitem.headline: Harveys Casino to sell Hard Rock stake.

text.p: Harveys Casino Resorts has agreed to sell its stake in Hard Rock Hotel & Casino to joint venture partner Hard Rock Hotel Inc. for $45 million in cash, the companies said Wednesday.
The partners said Harveys and Hard Rock founder Peter Morton had different ideas on how to best manage and evolve the Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.
Harveys will continue to manage the hotel until the deal closes. No personnel changes are expected, they said.
The deal, which is expected to take four to six months to complete, is subject to approval by Nevada gaming authorities.
Harveys stock fell 75 cents to $17.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in consolidated early afternoon trading.
